title: Fiber Offers v1 conformance test vectors
notes: Every value here is fixed. An implementation conforms when it reproduces each output and refuses each invalid case.
Error codes are those of the reference implementation (@fiber-offers/protocol). Another implementation must refuse the same cases; matching the code is recommended, not required.
The keys below are derived from the published seed labels (seed = SHA-256 of the label). They are test keys.
Unless a vector gives its own "now", the current time is 1800000000 (unix seconds).

offer.seed_label: fiber-offers test vector: offer key v1

subscriber.seed_label: fiber-offers test vector: subscriber key v1

stranger.seed_label: fiber-offers test vector: stranger key v1

type_script_hashes.name: secp256k1_blake160 lock (mainnet system script), empty args

valid_offers.name: fixed-price CKB offer
valid_offers.note: The smallest useful offer: one asset, one amount.

valid_offers.name: open amount with a minimum
valid_offers.note: No amount_max: the payer chooses any amount of at least amount_min.

valid_offers.name: no amount bounds
valid_offers.note: Neither bound: any positive amount. Absent fields are left out of the JSON entirely.

valid_offers.name: token offer (UDT) alongside CKB
valid_offers.note: A token is named by the hash of its CKB type script.

valid_offers.name: RGB++ asset
valid_offers.note: Same rule as a UDT: asset_type rgbpp, identified by type_script_hash.

valid_offers.name: single-use offer with an expiry
valid_offers.note: expiry is a JSON integer of unix seconds.

valid_offers.name: recurring offer capped by cycles
valid_offers.note: Each subscriber may pay at most cap_cycles cycles.

valid_offers.name: recurring offer with a custom interval and a spending cap
valid_offers.note: custom_seconds is present only with the custom_seconds interval.

valid_offers.name: metadata and extension fields
valid_offers.note: Free-form signed content. Number-like keys show the member order that matters.

valid_offers.name: mainnet offer with a resolver path
valid_offers.note: resolver_url keeps a path and drops the trailing slash.

valid_offers.name: dev network over plain http
valid_offers.note: http is acceptable on the dev network, or for a loopback address on any network.

valid_offers.name: non-ASCII description
valid_offers.note: Text is UTF-8; the description limit is counted in bytes.

valid_offers.name: free-form content at the depth limit
valid_offers.note: The value of metadata, of extensions and of an x_ field is at depth 0, and nothing may be deeper than 8. Each of these reaches depth 8: with text, with a number, and with an empty list.

normalization.name: loosely written input
normalization.note: A producer brings its input to canonical form before taking the ID. This input yields the fixed-price CKB offer above.

invalid_offers.name: description changed after signing
invalid_offers.note: The ID no longer matches the content.

invalid_offers.name: content and ID changed, signature kept
invalid_offers.note: The ID is right for the new content; the signature is not.

invalid_offers.name: signed by another Ed25519 key
invalid_offers.note: A valid signature, but not by the key the offer names.

invalid_offers.name: P-256 key under the ed25519 scheme
invalid_offers.note: The signature really is by the named key (ECDSA with SHA-256), so a verifier that does not check the key type accepts it.

invalid_offers.name: uppercase node_id
invalid_offers.note: Validly signed, not canonical.

invalid_offers.name: amount with leading zeros
invalid_offers.note: Validly signed, not canonical.

invalid_offers.name: amount as a JSON number
invalid_offers.note: Amounts are strings.

invalid_offers.name: resolver_url with a trailing slash
invalid_offers.note: Validly signed, not canonical.

invalid_offers.name: lowercase asset symbol
invalid_offers.note: Validly signed, not canonical.

invalid_offers.name: null for an absent field
invalid_offers.note: An absent field is left out, never null.

invalid_offers.name: public key with a trailing newline
invalid_offers.note: Validly signed, not canonical.

invalid_offers.name: unknown top-level field
invalid_offers.note: Only extensions and x_ fields may be added.

invalid_offers.name: missing network
invalid_offers.note: network is required.

invalid_offers.name: unsupported version
invalid_offers.note: A v1 reader refuses any other version.

invalid_offers.name: plain http on testnet
invalid_offers.note: http only on dev or for a loopback address.

invalid_offers.name: recurrence amount outside the bounds
invalid_offers.note: No cycle could ever be paid.

invalid_offers.name: zero amount
invalid_offers.note: Zero would be a second way to write 'no bound'.

invalid_offers.name: fraction in metadata
invalid_offers.note: Free-form signed content takes whole numbers only.

invalid_offers.name: metadata nested nine deep
invalid_offers.note: A value at depth 9, counting metadata itself as depth 0.

invalid_offers.name: extensions nested nine deep
invalid_offers.note: The same limit, counted the same way, for an extension field.

invalid_offers.name: an x_ field nested nine deep
extra member in the signature object
invalid_offers.note: It would not be covered by the signature.

invalid_offers.name: padded signature value
invalid_offers.note: base64url without padding is the one spelling.

invalid_offers.name: unsigned __proto__ member beside a signed offer
invalid_offers.note: Given as JSON text. A verifier that builds a sorted object loses this member and accepts the offer.
